items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I was 14 years old when a man by the name of Ernest Moore... started a band to teach young boys to play music; and I joined this band.

ctx.x: The Sterling Hotel had big dances in the winter and I could hear the music coming from the ballroom from outside, but it was not as interesting as in the summer when Clarence would play in Sinton Park.

I was 14 years old when a man by the name of Ernest Moore, who used to play in the band with my father, Uncle Ernest and Uncle John in Centerville and was now living in Cincinnati, started a band to teach young boys to play music; and I joined this band. I never knew how Mr. Ernest Moore managed to do what he was doing, because he was not a rich man and he did not charge for teaching the boys. I am certain that he could not afford to buy all the instruments he had and he allowed us to take them home. There must…
